title: Capacity review
prompt: [MEETING] Capacity review — company week 8, day 3 (2026-08-08). Review capacity: call company_headcount and list_issues, work out how much work sits per builder and which skill is the bottleneck (frontend, backend, testing, design). If the team is overloaded, hire_agent for that one role now - it is your decision. If someone has had no work for several cycles, consider fire_agent. Ask the tech lead what they actually need. Record the reasoning.
